scholarships.name: International Onshore Scholarship
scholarships.description: To be eligible for the $1,000 International Onshore Scholarship, you must:
eligibility: International applicants already living in Canada could be eligible for a one-time $1,000 entrance scholarship.
Apply for an eligible full-time program starting Winter (January), Summer 2027 (May) and Fall 2027 (September).
Be enrolled as a full-time international student past the withdrawal deadline (the 10th day of classes) for the awarded term.
Scholarship funds will be disbursed into eligible student accounts as a credit after the 10th day of classes.

The number of eligible applicants may exceed the funding for this one-time scholarship. If eligible applications exceed the funds available, scholarships will be awarded on a first-come, first-served basis to applicants who have accepted their offer of admission and completed required tuition payments.

scholarships.name: Bachelor's Degree Scholarships for EAP Graduates
eligibility: Graduates of Humber's English for Academic Purposes (EAP) program with a GPA of 80% or higher in Level 8, who are applying for a Bachelor’s Degree, will be eligible to receive a one-time non-renewable scholarship of $1,500.
renewal_conditions: Graduates of Humber's English for Academic Purposes (EAP) program with a GPA of 80% or higher in Level 8, who are applying for a Bachelor’s Degree, will be eligible to receive a one-time non-renewable scholarship of $1,500.

scholarships.name: Degree Transfer Scholarships
eligibility: Humber automatically awards degree transfer scholarships to students entering any Humber degree program who have completed a one-year Ontario college certificate* or a two- or three-year diploma with a GPA of 80 per cent or more from a publicly-funded college. Students who have achieved a program GPA of 80 per cent or more will be awarded a one-time scholarship of $1,500 for a certificate program or $2,500 for a diploma program in recognition of their academic achievement. Certificates and diplomas do not have to be related to the degree program of choice and are not tied to the eligibility for advanced standing or transfer credit. No application is required.

scholarships.name: Senior Dean's Bachelor of Commerce Award
scholarships.description: In Winter, Fall 2027, and Winter 2028, Humber will award all new semester one international students $10,000 entering any of the Bachelor of Commerce (BComm) programs.
scholarships.value_text: $10,000 total ($2,500 per semester for four semesters)

scholarships.name: LanguageCert University and College Pathways Scholarship
eligibility: International students enrolled in a preparatory or pathway English program at Humber Polytechnic, where LanguageCert tests are recognized as proof of English proficiency, and who have conditional acceptance into a Canadian degree or diploma program are eligible to apply for a $1,000 scholarship.

notes: Only international entrance scholarships and admission awards are exported; the President's International Entrance Award is excluded because it is a bursary, and EAP/current-student awards and external awards are excluded.
